outcome: Give game studio cto / live operations director a governed method to improve new player tutorial completion rate using tutorial milestones, churn and controller events, with final decisions retained…
overview: Player Onboarding Friction Analytics addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in gaming and esports operations. The first proof of value uses tutorial milestones, churn and controller events. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is new player tutorial completion rate, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: tutorial milestones, churn and controller events; define new player tutorial completion rate and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Game Studio CTO / Live Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
